payload.rationale: Each profile selects 5 constraint-passing candidates that maximize the respective U metric while ensuring diversity (>=3 lambda ranks). For expression, ld1 and ld4 dominate with high CAI; stability favors ld10 for its stem structures and moderate MFE; balanced combines ld4, ld1, and ld10. All candidates pass constraints C1/C2/C6/C7/M1/CAI. U values are clearly separated, eliminating the need for tie-breaking.
